html:
Common abbreviations, with descriptions and link to external/internal resources if available.

Events

X something

Means that someone is making a raid for event and asks other people to join them. In Archeage Classic there is no party search, so players have to resort on addons that do the automatic invitation based on a message in the chat. If someone is making a raid for Whalesong there will be a lot of x ws messages and by typing it yourself you will get an automatic invite to this raid. Same goes to any other content with X and name of the event or boss. Usually raid leader announces in the nation/faction chat what they are about to do example: "x cr is up".

  • CR - Crimson Rift
  • GR - Grimghast Rift
  • OC - Ocleera Rift
  • WH/WS - Whalesong Harbor siege
  • Aegis - Aegis Island defending the seal
  • Halcy - Halcyona, Battle for the Golden Plains
  • Rice/Veroe - Veroe Harvest Festival
  • Fort - Fortress which appears in Diamond Shores which requires purifying
  • Puri - Purification of castle areas
  • DS - Friday Diamond shore pvp event
  • Fish - Saturday fishing event
  • Andy/Anth - Anthalon, and Sunday anthalon kill event
  • Comet - Custom nation vs nation content with bunch of quests, Starfall
  • Lusca - Luscas are so called mini-krakens that spawn in the middle of the sea. Each big city has a big portal that ports players closer from where they continue to the water bosses with a ships. A quest is given near the portal to kill 5 lusca in order to get quest reward.

Dungeons

  • Serp - Serpentis
  • Dahuta - Sea of Drowned Love
  • GHA - Greater Howling abyss
  • HOA - Heart of Ayanad Guardian

World Bosses

  • JMG - Jola, Meina and Glenn, world boss kill rotation
  • Morph - Morpheus pirate world boss
  • DGS - Delphinad Ghost Ship
  • RD - Red Dragon
  • Kraken/Primal Kraken -

Classes

  • DR - Darkrunner
  • SK - Skullknight
  • Rev - Revenant
  • Rezzer - Soothsayer who focuses on reviving people
  • Odekitten / Raids Ode - Highest healing power cleric

General stuff

  • WTB - Want to buy
  • WTS - Want to sell
  • WTT - Want to trade
  • LFG/LFM - Looking for group / looking for more
  • Timmy - Low gearscore player or player who just joined the game, new player
  • Pugs/pug raid - Pick-Up Group, a group consisting of random players usually without voice coms or any organicing.

Equipment

  • Aya - Ayanad
  • Obs/Obi - Obsidian
  • ss - Short spear
  • ls - Long spear
  • gs - Gear score
  • T1-7 - Obsidian equipment is crafted at Tier 1, and can be upgraded through to Tier 7

Items

  • MGP - Mysterious Garden Powder - A common crafting ingredient
  • Charc - Charcoal Stabilizer, a common crafting ingredient from inter-continental ocean trade runs

Locations

  • Lib - Ayanad Library
  • Hasla - Generally used to either refer to the Hasla Rift or Veroe Harvest Festival
wikitext:
Common abbreviations, with descriptions and link to external/internal resources if available.

=== Events ===
'''X ''something'''''

Means that someone is making a raid for event and asks other people to join them. In Archeage Classic there is no party search, so players have to resort on addons that do the automatic invitation based on a message in the chat. If someone is making a raid for Whalesong there will be a lot of x ws messages and by typing it yourself you will get an automatic invite to this raid. Same goes to any other content with X and name of the event or boss. Usually raid leader announces in the nation/faction chat what they are about to do example: "x cr is up".
* CR - [https://www.ign.com/wikis/archeage/Crimson_Rift Crimson Rift]
* GR - [https://www.ign.com/wikis/archeage/Grimghast_Rift Grimghast Rift]
* OC - [https://www.ign.com/wikis/archeage/Ocleera_Rift Ocleera Rift]
* WH/WS - [https://www.ign.com/wikis/archeage/Whalesong_Harbor Whalesong Harbor siege]
* Aegis - [https://www.ign.com/wikis/archeage/Aegis_Island Aegis Island defending the seal]
* Halcy - [https://www.ign.com/wikis/archeage/Battle_for_the_Golden_Plains Halcyona, Battle for the Golden Plains]
* Rice/Veroe - [[Veroe Harvest Festival]]
* Fort - Fortress which appears in Diamond Shores which requires purifying
* Puri - Purification of castle areas
* DS - [[Crystalline Bloodbath|Friday Diamond shore pvp event]]
* Fish - [[Fishing quest|Saturday fishing event]]
* Andy/Anth - [https://www.ign.com/wikis/archeage/Anthalon Anthalon, and Sunday anthalon kill event]
* Comet - Custom nation vs nation content with bunch of quests, [[Starfall]]
* Lusca - Luscas are so called mini-krakens that spawn in the middle of the sea. Each big city has a big portal that ports players closer from where they continue to the water bosses with a ships. A quest is given near the portal to kill 5 lusca in order to get quest reward.

=== Dungeons ===

*Serp - [https://www.ign.com/wikis/archeage/Serpentis Serpentis]
* Dahuta - [https://www.ign.com/wikis/archeage/Sea_of_Drowned_Love Sea of Drowned Love]
* GHA - [https://www.ign.com/wikis/archeage/Howling_Abyss Greater Howling abyss]
* HOA - [https://www.ign.com/wikis/archeage/Heart_of_Ayanad_Guardian Heart of Ayanad Guardian]

=== World Bosses ===

*JMG - [https://archeagecodex.com/us/npc/12649/ Jola], [https://www.ign.com/wikis/archeage/Meina_&_Glenn Meina and Glenn], world boss kill rotation
* Morph - [https://www.ign.com/wikis/archeage/Morpheus_the_Forsaken Morpheus] pirate world boss
* DGS - [https://archeagecodex.com/us/npc/15092/ Delphinad Ghost Ship]
* RD - [https://www.ign.com/wikis/archeage/Red_Dragon Red Dragon]
* Kraken/Primal Kraken - 

=== Classes ===

* DR - [https://archeagecodex.com/us/calc/476492/ Darkrunner]
* SK - [https://archeagecodex.com/us/calc/113232 Skullknight]
* Rev - [https://archeagecodex.com/us/calc/558150 Revenant]
* Rezzer - Soothsayer who focuses on reviving people
* Odekitten / Raids Ode - Highest healing power cleric

=== General stuff ===

* WTB - Want to buy
* WTS - Want to sell
* WTT - Want to trade
* LFG/LFM - Looking for group / looking for more
* Timmy - Low gearscore player or player who just joined the game, new player
* Pugs/pug raid - Pick-Up Group, a group consisting of random players usually without voice coms or any organicing.

=== Equipment ===

* Aya - Ayanad
* Obs/Obi - Obsidian
* ss - Short spear
* ls - Long spear
* gs - Gear score
* T1-7 - Obsidian equipment is crafted at Tier 1, and can be upgraded through to Tier 7

=== Items ===

* MGP - [https://archeagecodex.com/us/item/23653/ Mysterious Garden Powder] - A common crafting ingredient
* Charc - [https://archeage.fandom.com/wiki/Charcoal_Stabilizer Charcoal Stabilizer], a common crafting ingredient from [https://www.ign.com/wikis/archeage/Trade_Payment inter-continental ocean trade runs]

=== Locations ===

* Lib - [https://www.ign.com/wikis/archeage/Ayanad_Library Ayanad Library]
* Hasla - Generally used to either refer to the [https://www.ign.com/wikis/archeage/Hasla_Weapons_(Tokens) Hasla Rift] or [[Veroe Harvest Festival]]
